title: Community choir invitation
brief:
You organize a community choir’s informal semester-end concert and want to invite the residents of a nearby apartment building that has hosted your rehearsals. Write a short invitation the building manager can forward. The concert is on June 6 at 5 p.m. in the Maple Room at the neighborhood center. Admission is free, the performance runs about 35 minutes, and seating is first come, first served. Thank residents for sharing their common room on Tuesday evenings and give them a clear invitation to attend.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

5f2426b5250a85bd.text:
Dear neighbors,

On Tuesday evenings, you’ve shared your common room with our community choir and given us a place to sing together. Thank you for making room for us each week. We’d love for you to hear the songs we’ve been rehearsing.

Please join us for our informal semester-end concert on June 6 at 5 p.m. in the Maple Room at the neighborhood center. Admission is free, and the performance will run about 35 minutes. Seating is first come, first served. We hope to see you there!

6730735a9846482e.text:
Dear residents,

You’re invited to our community choir’s informal end-of-semester concert on June 6 at 5 p.m. in the Maple Room at the neighborhood center.

Thank you for sharing your common room with us on Tuesday evenings. Having a place to rehearse together each week has meant a lot to us, and we’d love for you to hear what we’ve been working on.

Admission is free, the concert will last about 35 minutes, and seating is first come, first served. We hope you’ll join us!
